title.zh: 黄石：人类帮助狼重返公园

answer.zh: 1995年与1996年，人类分两批将灰狼重新引入黄石，这是一次有日期、有数量记录的野生动物保育行动。
answer.en: In 1995 and 1996, people reintroduced gray wolves to Yellowstone in two documented groups, making this a dated conservation action.

explanation.zh: 1995年1月的14只和1996年1月的17只狼，分批运入适应围栏，随后才逐步放归。狼的回归改变了捕食者与猎物的关系：它们捕食马鹿，猎物剩余部分也为食腐动物提供食物。NPS同时介绍了保护、猎捕与不同物种的相互作用，提醒我们生态恢复并不是一个单一角色改变一切的故事。
explanation.en: The 14 wolves brought in January 1995 and the 17 in January 1996 first entered acclimation pens before later releases. Their return changed predator-prey relationships: wolves prey on elk, and remains of their kills also feed scavengers. The NPS account describes protection, hunting and interactions between species, reminding us that ecological recovery is not a story in which one actor changes everything.

text.zh: NPS的管理史记录1995年1月带入14只狼。
text.en: The NPS management history records 14 wolves brought in during January 1995.

text.zh: 1996年1月的第二批为17只；管理记录将其与前一年的行动区分。
text.en: The second group, brought in during January 1996, comprised 17 wolves and is recorded separately from the previous year's action.

caveats.zh: 这是人类保育事件，不是灰狼起源年代，也不代表公园中心就是放生点。
caveats.en: These are conservation events, not the origin of gray wolves, and the park-centre marker is not a release location.

caveats.zh: 恢复后的生态变化不能全部归因于狼；这两次历史事件也不是此刻正在发生的事件。
caveats.en: Subsequent ecological changes cannot all be attributed to wolves, and these historical releases are not events happening now.

timeNote.zh: 分别记录1995年1月与1996年1月运入适应围栏的事件，不是连续放生期，也不是自由放归的日期。现今参考基图仅作公园区域示意，不表示围栏位置或历史海岸线。
timeNote.en: These dates separately record arrival in acclimation pens in January 1995 and January 1996, not a continuous release period or the dates of release into the wild. The present-day reference basemap illustrates the park region, not pen locations or historical coastlines.

name.zh: 黄石国家公园区域，美国
name.en: Yellowstone National Park region, United States

precision.zh: 公园区域示意锚点，不是放生、狼穴或个体出现位置；不提供特定事件的精确位置，测量误差未知。
precision.en: A park-region illustration anchor, not a release site, den or individual occurrence. It does not locate a particular place within the park; measured uncertainty is unknown.

title.zh: Skåne：树木也能留下自然记录
title.en: Skåne: trees can become nature records

answer.zh: 瑞典Skåne的一条2025年夏栎观察，展示了树木怎样进入有日期、有位置说明的生物多样性记录。
answer.en: A 2025 pedunculate oak observation in Skåne, Sweden, shows how trees enter biodiversity records with documented dates and locations.

explanation.zh: Artportalen的观察经GBIF汇集，记录的植物为夏栎Quercus robur。坐标附有250米的位置不确定度，不能理解为没有误差的单树定位。这样的记录有助于认识物种出现的地点，但单次观察不能说明当地全部树木、被观察树木的年龄，或至今是否仍在原处。
explanation.en: The Artportalen observation, shared through GBIF, identifies Quercus robur. Its coordinates carry 250 metres of uncertainty, not an error-free position for an individual tree. Such records help document where species occur, but one observation does not describe all local trees, their ages or their continued presence today.

text.zh: GBIF记录5004569926列出Quercus robur，记录类型为人工观察，所报日期为2025年1月1日。
text.en: GBIF occurrence 5004569926 identifies Quercus robur as a human observation with a reported date of 1 January 2025.

text.zh: 原记录提供WGS84经纬度及250米位置不确定度，未提供个体数量，也没有附带观察照片。
text.en: The original record provides WGS84 coordinates and 250 metres of coordinate uncertainty, but no individual count or attached observation photograph.

caveats.zh: 记录所报日期不能直接用于推断萌芽、开花等物候，也不能确定被观察树木的年龄。
caveats.en: The reported date does not establish budding or flowering behaviour or the ages of the observed trees.

caveats.zh: 一次观察不能证明当地自古原生或一直存在至2026年；异地同种照片也不是此条观察的实拍。
caveats.en: One observation does not prove long-term native status or presence through 2026; a photograph of the same species elsewhere is not this observation's photograph.

timeNote.zh: 2025年1月1日为数据所报日期，不另行推断季节行为或持续出现期。位置以现今参考基图展示，这不是实时树木监测。
timeNote.en: 1 January 2025 is the date reported in the data, not a basis for inferring seasonal behaviour or continuous presence. The location uses a present-day reference basemap; this is not live tree monitoring.

name.en: Hässlebjär, near Torna Hällestad, Skåne, Sweden

precision.zh: 原记录给出250米位置不确定度，不应缩成无误差的单树位置。
precision.en: The record supplies 250 metres of positional uncertainty; it should not be reduced to an error-free location for one tree.

title.zh: 黄石狼群：截至2025年底的公开监测
title.en: Yellowstone wolves: public monitoring through the end of 2025

answer.zh: NPS报告称，截至2025年12月底，黄石国家公园有84只狼，分属7个狼群，另有1个新形成的群体；这不是实时数量。
answer.en: The NPS reports 84 wolves in seven packs and one new group in Yellowstone National Park at the end of December 2025; this is not a live count.

explanation.zh: 这份2026年发表的2025年报，还记录了3对繁殖配对，并介绍航空、地面和GPS点簇调查等方法。数字背后是有时间范围、调查方法与区域边界的监测工作，不是一张能随时显示每只狼位置的地图。它可以帮助理解保护工作的进展，但不应被读成2026年某一天的现场情况。
explanation.en: The 2025 report, published in 2026, also records three breeding pairs and describes aerial, ground and GPS-cluster investigations. These figures come from monitoring with a defined period, methods and geographical scope, not a map showing every wolf at every moment. They help explain conservation work, but they do not establish conditions on a particular day in 2026.

text.zh: 年报第2页概括2025年12月底的84只狼、7个狼群、另1个新群体和3对繁殖配对。
text.en: Page 2 summarizes 84 wolves, seven packs, one additional new group and three breeding pairs at the end of December 2025.

text.zh: 第3页说明航空、地面与GPS点簇调查；第24页标明报告于2026年发表，编号YCR-2026-01。
text.en: Page 3 describes aerial, ground and GPS-cluster work; page 24 identifies the publication year as 2026 and the report as YCR-2026-01.

caveats.zh: 这份官方公开资料描述的是2025年底，而不是2026年某一天的实时数量；报告发表年与数据截至年份不同。
caveats.en: This official public report describes the end of 2025, not a live count on a day in 2026. Publication year and population-reference year differ.

caveats.zh: 数量范围是黄石国家公园，不是整个大黄石生态系统；区域锚点不是个体、狼穴或狼群领地边界。
caveats.en: The population scope is Yellowstone National Park, not the whole Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem. The regional anchor is not an individual, den or pack-territory boundary.

timeNote.zh: 概况截至2025年12月底，不表示整月每天都是84只；报告2026年发表，2026-11-05核对，非实时。现今参考基图只作公园区域示意，不是动物即时分布或历史海岸线。
timeNote.en: The summary is as of the end of December 2025, not a claim of 84 wolves on every day that month. The report was published in 2026 and checked on 2026-11-05; it is not live. The present-day reference basemap illustrates the park region, not immediate animal distributions or historical coastlines.

name.zh: 黄石国家公园区域，美国
name.en: Yellowstone National Park region, United States

precision.zh: 公园区域概述的示意锚点，不是动物出现点；实测位置误差未知。
precision.en: An illustration anchor for a park-region overview, not an animal occurrence point; measured positional uncertainty is unknown.
